name: Apple Music

fastest.text: Sign in at music.apple.com, open your account settings and manage subscriptions. On iPhone: Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

steps: Go to music.apple.com in a web browser and sign in with your Apple Account.
Open your account menu, then Settings.
Select Cancel Subscription. If the site won't let you, cancel on iPhone in Settings → your name → Subscriptions → Apple Music.
note: Pay for Apple Music through Google Play? Cancel in the Apple Music app on Android or at play.google.com.

faq.a: Catalog music stops playing when the paid period ends. Music you had on your device before subscribing stays, and Sync Library turns off.
Then the subscription is already cancelled. If it says Expires instead of Renews, it simply ends on that date.

faq.q: Does deleting the app cancel Apple Music?
faq.a: No. Deleting the app doesn't cancel the subscription.
Apple Music Student is $6.99/mo in the US for eligible students.
